description: This script automates the configuration process for OpenWRT builds by generating a configuration file based on various grep filters and invoking several other scripts and tools (such as conf, kconfig.pl). It manages configuration stages and cleans up temporary files after execution.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Build automation tool invoked to run configuration scripts.

methods.name: grep
methods.description: Searches for specific configuration options in the .config file and appends the results to temporary files.

methods.name: cat
methods.description: Outputs the contents of temporary configuration head files.

methods.name: rm
methods.description: Removes temporary files created during the script execution.

methods.name: exit
methods.description: Terminates the script with a status code if an error occurs during the make command.
